zh: 奥雷里亚诺·布恩迪亚上校以为他的死亡
en: Colonel Aureliano Buendía thought that death would be announced

zh: 将以一种明确的、毫不含糊的斩钉截铁的方式宣告其到来
en: with a definite, unequivocal, irrevocable signal

zh: 但直到被处决的前一刻
en: But just moments before his death

zh: 这世间的每一个人都是孤独无依
en: every single person in this world, is alone
But man was not born to be eternal

zh: 我们生来就是为了死去

en: and oblivion in the hearts of men
